header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: choose good words and speak them,” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Amr ibn Abasah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of “the right side of Ar-Rahman” is that they have a special rank with Allah. And the meaning of “both hands of Ar-Rahman are right hands” is that just as the right hand is honoured, Allah too is honoured. Although the rank of the Prophets and martyrs is higher than that of those people, their envying them is because of these people's special deeds.
(Majma' Bihar al-Anwar)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ ﵁ قَالَ: نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ عَلَي رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ فِي بَعْضِ أَبْيَاتِهِ (وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدوَةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ۞) الآية خَرَجَ يَلْتَمِسُ فَوَجَدَ قَوْماً يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ تَعَالَي مِنْهُمْ ثَائِرُ الرَّاْسِ وَجَافُّ الْجِلْدِ وَذُو الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ فَلَمَّا رَآهُمْ جَلَسَ مَعَهُمْ وَقَالَ: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي أُمَّتِي مَنْ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَصْبِرَ نَفْسِي مَعَهُمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdur Rahman ibn Sahl ibn Hunaif (RA) says, “When the Prophet ﷺ was in his house, the Ayah (وَاصْبِرْ )نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدوَةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ“(O Prophet) Restrain yourself to sit with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening!” was revealed. The Prophet ﷺ went out searching for such people. He found a group engaged in the Dhikr of Allah. Among them some had dishevelled hair, some had dry skin, and some were wearing only a single garment.
